questions.text: «He asked: “Where do you live?”» ni o'zlashtirmaga aylantiring
options: He asked where do I live
He asked where did I live
questions.explanation: O'zlashtirma savolda oddiy so'z tartibi: do/does/did va savol belgisi tushadi.

questions.text: «She asked: “Do you like it?”» ni o'zlashtirmaga aylantiring
options: She asked do I like it
She asked if I liked it
She asked that I liked it
questions.explanation: Yes/No savol → ask + if/whether + ega + fe'l.

options: He told me to sit down
He said me to sit down
He told to me sit down
questions.explanation: Buyruq → tell + odam + TO + V1.

options: He told me not to go
He told me to not go
questions.explanation: Inkor buyruq: ... NOT TO + V1.

questions.text: Iltimosni yetkazish uchun qaysi fe'l ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: She asked me to wait. Buyruq uchun esa tell/order/warn.
«suggest to» va «suggest me to» — xato. To'g'risi: suggest going / suggest that we go.

questions.text: «advise, remind, warn» qaysi naqsh bilan keladi?
questions.explanation: He advised me to rest. Inkor: not to V1.
He admitted stealing it. He denied knowing her.
apologize FOR, insist ON, accuse OF, congratulate ON.

questions.text: «promise, offer, agree, refuse» qaysi naqsh bilan?
questions.explanation: He promised to help. She refused to answer.
must be — aniq ishonch bilan chiqarilgan xulosa (majburiyat emas).
Salbiy xulosa — CAN'T; mustn't esa TA'QIQ ma'nosini beradi.
He must have forgotten. can't have + V3, might have + V3.
must've talaffuzi «must of» ga o'xshaydi, lekin yozilishi «must have».

questions.text: Ehtimolni bildirish uchun qaysi modal ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: «can be» ehtimol uchun ishlatilmaydi. Inkor ehtimol: might not.

title: Test — Had better, would rather, ought to

questions.text: «had better» dan keyin qanday fe'l keladi?
questions.explanation: You'd better hurry. Inkor: You'd better not go.
I'd rather stay. rather X than Y.
Boshqa odam haqida gapirganda: I'd rather you went now.

options: ought to — «to» bilan; had better — «to» siz
questions.explanation: ought to = should muqobili: You ought to rest.

questions.text: «I was supposed to call» nimani anglatadi?
options: Qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak edi, lekin qilmadim
questions.explanation: be supposed to: qoida, bajarilmagan reja yoki mish-mish (It's supposed to be good).
O'tmishga qarash: should have called, could have told.

questions.text: «I should have called» qanday ma'no beradi?
options: Afsus — qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak edi, qilmadim
questions.explanation: shouldn't have + V3 esa: noto'g'ri ish qildim.

questions.text: «You could have told me!» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: Ko'pincha norozilik ohangi bilan aytiladi.
Keraksiz bajarilgan ish haqida.
Talaffuz o'xshashligi tufayli keng tarqalgan imlo xatosi.
U otni aniqlaydi va gapdan ajratilmaydi.

questions.text: «the book ___ I read» — olmoshni tushirish mumkinmi?
questions.explanation: Ega olmoshi tushmaydi (the man who called), object olmoshi tushadi.

questions.text: «the book that I read it» — bu nega xato?
questions.explanation: Relative olmoshi allaqachon obyekt vazifasini bajaradi.
whose (egalik) ≠ who's (who is) — imlo tuzog'i.

questions.text: «the house I live ___ » — predlog qayerda turadi?
options: Oxirida: the house I live in
questions.explanation: Norasmiy uslubda predlog gap oxirida keladi.
My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor — qo'shimcha ma'lumot.
Bundan tashqari olmosh tushirilmaydi — majburiy.

questions.text: «He was late, ___ annoyed me» — bo'shliqqa nima?
questions.explanation: «which» butun gapga izoh berishi mumkin; «what» bu yerda xato.

questions.text: «the man who is waiting» ni qanday qisqartiramiz?
questions.explanation: Active reduced: who/which + be + V-ing → V-ing.

questions.text: «a book which was written in 1990» ni qanday qisqartiramiz?
questions.explanation: Passive reduced: who/which + be + V3 → V3.

questions.text: «I went ___ bread» (non olish uchun) — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Maqsad doim «to + V1» bilan beriladi.
My hobby is reading — kesim o'rnida ham gerund.
verb + OBJECT + to: want/tell/ask/allow/expect + odam + to.
Predlogdan keyin har doim -ing; bu yerda «to» — predlog.

questions.text: «remember to call» va «remember calling» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: Xuddi shunday: forget, stop, try, mean, go on.
